verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a mail platform with a developer API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only the Microsoft Graph REST mail API, and one doc says integration works in "any language or platform capable of sending HTTP requests." That describes raw HTTP access, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit toward this story. No official SDK appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
